summary: Iteration 3 tested no prices, the Blåkläder filter panel, the Hem start page with per-store and default text, admin store editors, login lockout, the confirm-link host allowlist, and a checkout regression. Backend: 17 of 18 new tests pass, plus 16 of 16 non-email regression tests. The one failure is a minor size-sort bug. Frontend: every requested flow works at 375x667. Two medium bugs were found: tapping the same Hem group tile again does not reselect the group, and an empty store title/text is accepted and then shows a blank Hem page. No deprecated Expo packages were detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: _size_key only treats sizes in _LETTER_SIZES as letter sizes. '4XL/5XL', '4XLS', '4XLT' and '7XL' match the numeric regex, so they are mixed into the numbers ('4','4XL/5XL','4XLS','4XLT','5',...,'7','7XL','8'). They should be sorted with the letter sizes, for example by matching ^\d?X+[SL]... before the numeric branch. Reference: server.py:297-306

An empty title and text are accepted and stored. Because store_for merges stored '' over DEFAULT_STORE, GET /api/home then returns title='' and text='', and the customer sees a blank Hem header. Either require title and text (min_length=1) or fall back to the default when a value is empty. Reference: server.py:210-228

There is no way to reset a city to the default start page (no DELETE endpoint or 'Använd standard' button). After one save, the city keeps a copy of the default text, so later edits to the default no longer reach that city.

Lockout is counted per email only, so anyone who knows an address can lock that user out for 15 minutes (account-lockout DoS). It is also count-then-insert, which is not atomic. Consider counting per IP+email, or a CAPTCHA/backoff. This is low priority and the behaviour matches the spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Repro: tap home-group-underdelar (shows 401), tap group-chip-alla (1236), go back to the Hem tab, tap home-group-underdelar again. The URL is /shop?group=underdelar but the list still shows 'Alla' with 1236 articles. Cause: the shop.tsx useEffect depends on [params.group], and that value has not changed, so the effect does not run again. Fix: pass a nonce param (for example t=Date.now()) or use useFocusEffect, or call router.setParams when a chip changes. Reference: app/(tabs)/shop.tsx:32-37

If GET /admin/stores/{id} fails, the form stays empty (q.isError is not handled), and Spara would overwrite the store with blank values. Also, no field is validated before saving. Reference: app/admin/store/[id].tsx:22-54

issues: The 'Startsidan sparad' success toast covers the Öppettider input just above the save button. This is cosmetic.
Facet counts are static: they are not recalculated after other selections, while 'Visa N' is live. This is acceptable but differs from Blåkläder.
Filters stay applied when the group changes. A selected value that does not exist in the new group's facets has no visible section, so it can only be removed with Rensa.

action_items: Fix shop.tsx so tapping the same Hem group tile again reselects that group (nonce param or useFocusEffect).
Validate the store PUT so an empty title/text is rejected (or falls back to the default), and add a 'reset to default' option (DELETE /api/admin/stores/{city_id}).
Fix _size_key so sizes like 4XL/5XL, 4XLS, 4XLT and 7XL are sorted with the letter sizes, not the numeric ones.
Clean up: remove the unused styles.price/priceNote in shop.tsx:278 and product/[id].tsx:167-168, and the unused formatPrice in src/components/ui.tsx:189.
Handle the error state of the admin store GET before allowing a save.
critical_code_review_comments: Prices: products are projected with price:0 in both the list and the detail endpoint, and no 'price' key appears anywhere in the JSON. The frontend shows no price or 'kr' text on cards, detail, cart or checkout.

public_base suffix matching uses leading-dot suffixes, so 'evilemergentagent.com' is rejected correctly. When X-Forwarded-Host was evil.example.com, the log showed 'Order confirm link base: https://workwear-order-2--7at9xelu.preview.emergentagent.com'.
Leftover price styles and formatPrice are dead code.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium bug when re-tapping a tile)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data. Throwaway test_lock_/test_reset_ users were created and deleted. The Borås and default store docs were restored (stores collection is empty again). login_attempts were cleaned up for test_ emails. Two test orders were sent to delivered@resend.dev (B10021 via API, B10022 via UI); both have email_status 'sent'.

For lockout tests use random test_ emails; non-existent emails are counted too. Filter option testIDs use the raw value, e.g. filter-option-Color-Svart and filter-option-Size-C50. rca_of_issue: Re-tap tile bug: Expo Router keeps the tab screen mounted. When the user pushes the same ?group=underdelar again, useLocalSearchParams returns an identical value, so useEffect([params.group]) does not run and the local state still shows the group chosen with the chip. Empty store bug: store_for merges a stored '' value over DEFAULT_STORE.
